Eliminate commute clutter

Every Silo wallet features a signature 4-slot coin organizer capable of holding up to 24 coins. You can also breeze through transit turnstiles thanks to our dedicated external tap-to-pay sleeve.

Denomination-labelled slots Zero-rattle tested
Shop Silo

Instant access,
ultimate protection

Features an aluminum cardholder, designed to instantly deploy your essential cards at the push of a button, with a maximum capacity of 8 cards. Integrates anti-RFID blocking to protect your sensitive data from unauthorized scanning.

Shop Silo

Colorful choices in leather

Offers the premium look and durability. Available in a range of colors to match your personal aesthetic. Cut, stitched, and edge-sealed by hand in Valenzuela City.

Shop Silo
Silo Core only

Left it on the jeep?
Find it from your phone

Silo Core includes a built-in smart tracking capability, so a lost wallet is findable from your phone. The tracker is slim and rechargeable, with no separate tag to carry or lose. Ring the wallet when it slips between the seats, or check where it last was before you double back for it.

What the commute actually looks like

We surveyed Metro Manila commuters before cutting a single pattern. Tap a commuter to see what they told us.

Hover or tap a commuter
88.78% struggle to find loose coins when paying their fare Digging for exact change on a moving jeepney is the single most common complaint in our survey, and the reason the coin organizer is the first thing you see when a Silo opens.
